youtube.title: Why Autumn Leaves Change Color 🍂 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The yellow and orange colours of autumn leaves come from carotenoid pigments that were in the leaf all summer. Green chlorophyll was drowning them out. As days shorten, trees stop rebuilding chlorophyll, it breaks down, and the yellows and oranges show through. Reds are different: they are made fresh in autumn by anthocyanin pigments.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
